initialExam.title: NDA II Examination 2026
initialExam.description: National Defence Academy Exam II for entry into Army, Navy, and Air Force wings. Exam scheduled September 13, 2026.
initialExam.qualifications: 12th pass with Physics, Chemistry & Math for Navy/Air Force
initialExam.syllabus: Paper-I: Mathematics (300 marks) - Algebra, Matrices, Trigonometry, Calculus, Statistics. Paper-II: GAT - English (200 marks) + General Knowledge (400 marks) covering Physics, Chemistry, GK, Geography, Current Events.
initialExam.examPattern: Paper-I: 120 questions, 300 marks, 2.5 hours. Paper-II: 150 questions, 600 marks, 2.5 hours. SSB Interview: 900 marks.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Exam → SSB Interview (5 days) → Medical → Final Merit
initialExam.jobRole: Cadet at National Defence Academy, Khadakwasla
initialExam.careerGrowth: Lieutenant → Captain → Major → Colonel → Brigadier → Major General → Lt General → General.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit upsc.gov.in 2. Apply online 3. Pay fee 4. Download admit card 5. Appear for exam
initialExam.perks: Free training, Accommodation, CSD canteen, Medical, Pension, Adventure activities
